about_title: Know when your internet fails, and prove it
contact_intro: Questions, problems or ideas: pick whichever is easiest for you.
contact_safety: Never send your config.json or log files unless we ask. They can contain your webhook, Telegram token and connection history.
contact_copy_failed: Couldn't copy. Select the text and copy it yourself.

story.1: Internet Monitor started with a familiar problem: the internet keeps dropping, and your provider says the line is fine. Without a record, it's your word against theirs.
story.2: So the app watches your connection quietly in the background, records every outage with its exact time, length and cause, and turns that into a report you can send. It also tells you whether the problem is in your home network or at your provider, so you know who to call.

local.title: Your data stays with you
local.body: Everything is stored on your computer. No account, no cloud, no tracking.

open.title: Free, with the code in the open

proof.title: Evidence, not guesses
proof.body: Exact times, durations and the layer that failed, ready for a PDF or CSV.
